repairSummary: Fixed public static page route from '/page/{pageSlug}' to '/{pageSlug}', matching ExpressCart's storefront catch-all route.
Targeted the visible Summernote editor container (.note-editable) and synchronized the underlying #pageContent value instead of relying on a hidden textarea.
Used actual form submit button selector #btnPageUpdate from editorTemplate.
Fixed cleanup in tearDown to locate the page's li.list-group-item and #btnPageDelete, handle confirmation dialogs (native alert or bootbox), and assert deletion without silently swallowing failures.
Handled admin re-authentication in tearDown if visiting the public storefront route modified the admin session.
assumptions: ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD environment variables or system properties provide administrative access.
BaseTest provides driver and appUrl initialized for testing.
